new.s: Under Article 108, what does the President do to start the process of a joint sitting of the two Houses?
o: He issues a direction to the Speaker to hold a joint sitting
He seeks the consent of the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
He notifies to the Houses his intention to summon them to a joint sitting
He refers the Bill to the Supreme Court for advice
new.x: Article 108 uses the words 'notifies his intention' to summon a joint sitting. After this, neither House proceeds further with the Bill.

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution provides for the Vote on Account?
new.x: Article 116 provides for the Vote on Account, a grant in advance for part of the year until the Budget is passed.

new.s: Which body prepares the Annual Financial Statement (Budget) of the Union?
o: Budget Division, Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance
Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance
new.x: The Budget Division of the Department of Economic Affairs in the Ministry of Finance prepares the Annual Financial Statement (Article 112).
new.angle: U0307 #9 Budget -> department preparing it

new.s: What happens to Bills pending before a House of Parliament when the House is adjourned sine die?
o: They do not lapse and are taken up in the next session
They are sent to a joint sitting
They are deemed to have been passed
new.x: Adjournment sine die ends a sitting without fixing a day to meet again; pending Bills do not lapse and continue in the next session.
new.angle: U0307 #11 Adjournment sine die -> effect on Bills

new.s: Which of the following is correct about Government Bills and Private Members' Bills?
o: A Private Member's Bill is passed in a single reading
A Government Bill needs one month's notice for introduction
A Private Member's Bill is drafted by the Law Ministry
Both pass through the same readings and stages in each House
new.x: Government and Private Members' Bills follow the same general procedure and stages. A Government Bill needs 7 days' notice and is drafted by the department with the Law Ministry.
new.angle: U0307 PYQ y0d38a7f6035 public vs private bill -> same procedure

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. A Private Member's Bill needs one month's notice before introduction.
2. The defeat of a Private Member's Bill means loss of confidence in the government.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: A Private Member's Bill needs one month's notice. Its defeat has no bearing on the government; only the defeat of a Government Bill signals loss of confidence.
new.angle: U0307 #7 Private member's bill vs government bill

new.s: Why is a 'pocket veto' possible for the President of India?
o: The President can return a Bill any number of times
The Constitution fixes no time limit for the President to decide on a Bill
The President can reject a Money Bill after the Rajya Sabha passes it
The President can refer every Bill to a joint sitting
new.x: Article 111 sets no time limit for the President's decision, so the President can keep a Bill pending. India has no qualified veto.
new.angle: U0307 notes gap: pocket veto -> no time limit

new.s: What happens if the Rajya Sabha does not return the Appropriation Bill to the Lok Sabha within 14 days?
o: It is deemed to have been passed by both Houses

new.x: The Appropriation Bill is a Money Bill. If the Rajya Sabha does not return it within 14 days, it is deemed passed by both Houses.
new.angle: U0307 notes gap: Appropriation Bill as Money Bill

new.s: On which Bill was the joint sitting of Parliament held in 1978?
